splitPolicy: Speaker-disjoint development/calibration/locked test. Keep every original and all its degradations together. Published neural model test partitions override generic splits; unknown training overlap is not held-out evidence.
decision: Choose tolerances before locked evaluation. Require fewer wrong pitch events without unacceptable quiet-speech losses, preserved genuine high speech, and acceptable measured phone latency. If no convincing winner, keep baseline.
